tabs.title: Company Overview
tabs.content:
**Tovana Health** operates a network of 14 hospitals and 60 outpatient clinics. The organization uses a single Microsoft Entra ID tenant (tovanahealth.org) and has 22,000 staff members, including clinicians, administrative staff, and a regional IT helpdesk team in each of its three regions.

**Current Environment:**
- All staff identities are synchronized from on-premises Active Directory using Microsoft Entra Connect
- Clinical applications are being migrated to Azure across eight subscriptions
- A central security team manages the tenant; regional helpdesk teams handle password resets and user support for their own region only
- Visiting physicians from partner research institutes are onboarded as guest users and often retain access long after their engagements end

tabs.title: Identity Requirements
tabs.content:
**Identity and Access Requirements:**
- Clinicians signing in from hospital-network workstations must not be prompted for MFA on every sign-in, but any sign-in from outside hospital networks must require MFA
- Users in the Global Administrator and Privileged Role Administrator roles must authenticate with phishing-resistant methods only
- Regional helpdesk teams must be able to reset passwords **only** for users in their own region — they must have no directory permissions over users in other regions
- Guest accounts for visiting physicians must be recertified periodically, and access must be removed automatically if the sponsoring department does not confirm it is still needed
- Administrative solutions must minimize the number of permanently privileged accounts
